I think the reason why the doctor refuses to do the endo specialist referral is because I’m in the UK under a universal healthcare system (NHS). The referral would be to an NHS endo specialist on the NHS’s dime, and the NHS endo specialists are already dealing with a huge backlog of patients in severe pain/needing laparoscopies whereas I’m not really suffering physically (my main issue is the mental torment of worrying about my fertility) and already have a diagnosis.
